method: Establishment-first desk research for home-style and regional dishes with 0 HCMC venues (Vietnamese queries; Michelin Guide, mia.vn, VnExpress, mytour, VinWonders). Pages read via search-result excerpts (direct fetches blocked) — spot-check. Hours only where the source states them; no prices because no source gives a dish price at these venues.

venues.name: Cục Gạch Quán

dishes.evidence: mia.vn lists canh chua cá lóc on Cục Gạch Quán's menu (10 Đặng Tất); the Michelin Guide entry (Bib Gourmand) mentions its signature canh chua but names the fish cá hú — spot-check the fish.

venues.note: Hours 09:00–23:30 daily per the Michelin Guide. Not linked to cá kho tộ: the source names cá rô kho tộ (climbing perch), not the catalogue's catfish/snakehead dish.

venues.name: Bánh canh Trảng Bàng Ba Xi

dishes.evidence: VnExpress reports the Ba Xi bánh canh Trảng Bàng shop opening at 135 Võ Văn Tần, Quận 3. Article is from 2011 — current operation unconfirmed, spot-check.

venues.name: Bánh canh Trảng Bàng Ông Cáo

dishes.evidence: Mytour's Bình Chánh breakfast list names Ông Cáo – Bánh Canh Trảng Bàng at 4D Võ Văn Vân (Vĩnh Lộc B), open 6:00–21:00.

venues.name: Chè Hiển Khánh

dishes.evidence: VinWonders' Saigon chè guide lists Chè Hiển Khánh (718 Nguyễn Đình Chiểu) serving bánh flan alongside xôi and rau câu.

venues.excluded: Geocoder placed No. 718 at the Quận 1 end of Nguyễn Đình Chiểu (street-level match, ~2 km off); not published until the exact location is confirmed.
